title: Smoothness under restriction to open subschemes, composition with an open immersion, and isomorphism
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $U\subseteq X$ and $V\subseteq S$ be open subschemes with inclusions $j_U:U\to X$, $j_V:V\to S$ and $f(U)\subseteq V$, and let $f_{U,V}:U\to V$ be the unique morphism with $j_V\circ f_{U,V}=f\circ j_U$ [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme]. Then: (a) if $f$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], then $f_{U,V}$ is smooth; (b) if $f_{U,V}$ is smooth, then $f\circ j_U:U\to S$ is smooth; (c) if $u:X'\to X$ and $v:S'\to S$ are isomorphisms of schemes and $f':X'\to S'$ satisfies $v\circ f'=f\circ u$, then $f$ is smooth if and only if $f'$ is smooth.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01V6 (lemma-smooth-characterize), final assertion, for (a); Lemma 01VC (lemma-open-immersion-smooth) and Lemma 01VA (lemma-composition-smooth) for (b); the smooth morphisms of Morphisms Section 01V4 are those of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] by More on Morphisms, Lemma 02H6
